name: Greg Ginis
bio:
Greg has proudly served the Jackson Soccer Club in several leadership roles over the years, including Director of Grounds, Vice President, and currently President. Throughout his tenure, Greg has remained committed to improving the club's facilities, strengthening the club's financial position, and creating the best possible experience for players and families.

One of Greg's most significant accomplishments has been negotiating and securing a 20-year lease agreement with Jackson Township for the Jackson Mills soccer complex, providing the club with long-term stability and the ability to invest confidently in its facilities. Greg also led the project to install LED field lighting at Jackson Mills, significantly expanding field availability for practices and games while improving the overall player experience. To help make this project financially responsible, Greg successfully introduced a grant that covered 50% of the lighting project's cost, reducing the financial impact on the club.

Outside of his volunteer leadership, Greg is also a Jackson Soccer Club parent. His two sons currently play in the club's 2011 and 2014 age groups, giving him firsthand insight into the experience of players and families. Having lived in Jackson for the past 15 years, Greg is deeply invested in the community and committed to ensuring that Jackson Soccer Club continues to grow and provide outstanding opportunities for current and future generations of players.

As President, Greg's focus remains on building a stronger, more sustainable club by investing in facilities, supporting player development, maintaining financial responsibility, and creating an environment where every player has the opportunity to learn, compete, and enjoy the game. Greg looks forward to continuing to add value to Jackson Soccer Club and serving the families that make the organization such an important part of the community.

name: Ryan Monday
bio:
Ryan has been proud to serve the Jackson Soccer Club as both a coach and board member for more than 15 years. During that time, he has had the opportunity to work alongside dedicated coaches, volunteers, and families who all share the same goal of providing young athletes with a positive and rewarding soccer experience.

One of the aspects Ryan enjoys most is working with coaches and parents to help navigate the ever-changing youth soccer landscape. He believes that open communication, collaboration, and a player-first approach are essential to creating an environment where every child can develop their skills, build confidence, and enjoy the game.

As a member of the Board of Directors, Ryan is committed to supporting initiatives that strengthen the club, promote player development, and provide coaches with the resources they need to succeed. He believes that a successful club is built on strong leadership, teamwork, and a shared commitment to doing what is best for the players.

Outside of Jackson Soccer Club, Ryan is actively involved with the Monmouth Ocean County Soccer Association (MOSA), where he continues to support the growth of youth soccer throughout the region. Professionally, Ryan is a teacher at Jackson Township High School, where he works with special education students. His experiences in the classroom have reinforced the importance of patience, encouragement, and creating opportunities for every child to succeed.

Ryan considers it an honor to serve on the Jackson Soccer Club Board of Directors and looks forward to continuing to work with the coaches, players, and families to help make Jackson Soccer Club a place where every player can grow, compete, and develop a lifelong love of the game.

name: Ashley Montgomery
bio:
Ashley has been a proud Jackson Soccer Club mom for the past six years. Her two boys started in the Recreation Program and are now both in the Travel Program. Her husband is also part of the coaching team for both boys’ teams. The Jackson Soccer Club has been such a positive experience for their entire family, and Ashley is now excited to join the Board this year.

Ashley has been a high school teacher for 16 years as well as a high school gymnastics coach for nine years. She is looking forward to helping this great program continue moving in a positive direction for years to come.

name: Ben Felicelli
bio:
Ben has been proudly affiliated with the Jackson Soccer Club since 2012 and has served as a parent, coach, and now board member. Both of his children have played their entire youth soccer careers in Jackson, and he can say the experience has been amazing. Playing with friends and the development provided by the coaches and Tecnica have been life-changing experiences for both of his children.

Currently, Ben serves as the Director of Grounds for the Club, overseeing the Justice Complex and Vista/Jackson Mills Fields. He would argue that Jackson Soccer Club has the best facilities in all of Ocean County, with five 5v5 fields, four 7v7 fields, three 9v9 fields, and three 11v11 fields.

Ben is committed to providing safe fields, clean fields, and an environment that children and parents can call home. The community and children’s sports experiences are the driving forces behind his volunteer commitment.

name: Hagos Rush
bio:
Hagos has been a coach with Jackson Soccer Club for more than two years and currently serves as Head Coach of Jackson United Red. What initially began as an opportunity to coach his son quickly developed into a genuine passion for teaching the game and watching players grow in their confidence, skills, and understanding of soccer.

His coaching philosophy focuses on developing intelligent, team focused players who learn to make decisions for themselves. He believes players should be encouraged to take chances, make mistakes, learn from them, and respond with maximum effort. Above all, his goal is to create an environment where players enjoy the game, develop as teammates and individuals, and build skills that extend beyond the soccer field.

Hagos is also a U.S. Soccer referee who has officiated at the ECNL Regional League Finals. He holds U.S. Soccer 7v7, 9v9, and 11v11 coaching licenses and is currently working toward his D License. Outside of soccer, he brings more than 14 years of leadership and people development experience, including coaching, mentoring, training, and building high performing teams.

A Jackson resident since 2020, Hagos joined the Board with a simple goal: to be helpful wherever he can. As Assistant Director of Fields & Grounds, he works alongside the Director to support and protect the club's facilities while exploring ways technology can improve how the club operates. He is also leading the redevelopment of the Jackson Soccer Club website and assists with MOSA responsibilities, including attending league meetings and sharing information back with the club.

name: Jason Blind
bio:
Jason has enjoyed serving as Co-Treasurer of the Jackson Soccer Club for almost two years, combining his professional background as a CPA with his passion for supporting youth sports in the community. In his role, he helps manage the club’s finances responsibly to ensure that resources are used to benefit the players, coaches and families. Additionally, he assists the club and individual teams with bookkeeping, monitoring the annual budget and tracking income and expenses.

Jason’s commitment to the club is also personal, as he has two sons who play for the 2010 and 2014 teams and has seen firsthand the positive impact playing on their teams has had on each of them. As a long time resident of over 20 years in Jackson, volunteering with the Jackson Soccer Club has afforded Jason the opportunity to give back to the community, and it has truly been rewarding for him to be able to do so. He looks forward to continuing to help the Jackson Soccer Club grow, while also maintaining a level of financial responsibility so that the club can continue to thrive and be successful.

name: Joel Levine
bio:
Coach Joel
Coach Joel is proud to have served the Jackson Soccer Club as a parent volunteer and coach and is excited to begin his first season as Director of the Recreation Program. After so many years on the field, one thing continues to stand out above everything else: the importance of the relationships and connections built along the way. Getting to know the players and their families and watching the soccer community come together is what makes this program so special.

Many know him as Coach Joel, but he is also a Jackson Soccer Club parent. His son and daughter have been part of the Recreation Program for the past five years and currently play in the Micro Kicker and Major League divisions. He has called Jackson home for 16 years, while his wife has been a Jackson resident for 31 years. This community means a great deal to their family, and they are committed to helping ensure the Jackson Soccer Club remains a place where local families can come together for years to come.

As he steps into this new role, his biggest goal is simple: to bring families together and create a positive, welcoming environment where everyone feels like they belong. He wants the fields to be a place where parents cheer each other on, children make new friends, players build confidence, and families create memories that last long after the season ends.

The Recreation Program has been a part of this community for many years, and Coach Joel believes its future depends on everyone standing together and continuing to invest in it. By getting involved, supporting one another, and encouraging more families to participate, the program can continue to grow and ensure that generations of Jackson residents and those from neighboring towns have the opportunity to learn, play, and love the game of soccer.

Coach Joel looks forward to the season ahead and to working alongside the players, families, coaches, and volunteers to make the Jackson Soccer Club stronger than ever. Most importantly, he looks forward to seeing everyone out on the fields and being part of the community that makes this program so special.

name: Mary Taveira
bio:
Mary is proud to have served as the Director of Fundraising for the Jackson Township Soccer Club for the past three years. She is a mom of three, and two of her children play on the club’s travel teams, so soccer has become a big part of her family life. Her oldest has been playing since he was five, and over the years Mary has developed a true appreciation for the dedication, teamwork, and community that youth soccer brings.

As Director of Fundraising, Mary works to organize and support fundraising efforts that help provide opportunities and resources for the club’s players and teams. She enjoys coming up with new ways to raise money while also bringing soccer families and the community together. One of her favorite events to plan and host each year is the annual Coaches Appreciation Dinner, where the club gets the opportunity to thank and celebrate the coaches who dedicate so much of their time and energy to the players.

Mary is always open to new ideas and loves hearing from soccer families and community members. Whether someone has a fundraising idea, a suggestion, or simply wants to share some feedback, she encourages them to reach out and communicate with her. Mary believes the best ideas come from working together, and she is always happy to listen and see how great ideas can be turned into opportunities for the club.

Mary is grateful to be part of such a great soccer community and looks forward to continuing to support the players, coaches, and families both on and off the field.

name: Mike Pinto
bio:
Mike Pinto is the volunteer Registrar for the Jackson Soccer Club. He has held the position for about a year and a half, and before that served two years as a recreational coach. He is currently the head coach of the travel U9 Boys Strikers, a role he has held for the past two seasons, and he has also coached flag football and currently coaches basketball as well.

He handles team rosters, player registration, and league administration so that coaches and players can focus entirely on the game. He also helps manage the club's social media pages, including Facebook, Instagram, and X.

A local parent of two, Mike is thrilled to support the community and help make every season organized and fun for everyone.
